requirements.Statement: Enable accountable, traceable order and payment status from intake through allocation and reporting.
requirements.Rationale: Reduce uncertainty and prevent lost exceptions.
requirements.Acceptance: Representative normal, blocked, cancelled and partially paid cases expose current stage, owner, remaining quantity/balance and evidence gaps.
requirements.Dependencies: Master data; linked documents; agreed role access
requirements.Validation: Trace review and planned UAT TC-001;TC-014;TC-017

requirements.Statement: Base fulfilment commitments and release on feasible supply, customer agreement and financial controls.
requirements.Rationale: Avoid unsupported promises and unauthorized shipments.
requirements.Acceptance: Stock shortage, partial permission and block cases follow rules; measures KPI-001/002/003 use the agreed definitions; no achieved improvement claimed.
requirements.Dependencies: Stock accuracy; credit policy; transit assumptions
requirements.Validation: Planned UAT TC-004 through TC-008; synthetic KPI checks

requirements.Statement: Make eligible fulfilled deliveries visible to Finance for timely, accurate and traceable billing.
requirements.Rationale: Remove avoidable handoff waiting without billing incorrectly.
requirements.Acceptance: Eligible delivery appears in review population without an email; correction/duplicate/error paths retain links and owner; KPI-004 includes unbilled context.
requirements.Dependencies: Posting accuracy; billing relevance; Finance ownership
requirements.Validation: Planned UAT TC-012;TC-013;TC-022

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall prevent order confirmation until required customer and order fields are valid.
requirements.Rationale: Customer data validation addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
requirements.Acceptance: Missing ship-to address or inactive customer prevents confirmation, identifies the field and preserves the draft; corrected data can be rechecked
requirements.Dependencies: Customer owner; approved field list; RULE-001
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-002;TC-003

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall see quantities, dates, blocks, related documents and accountable owner in one order view.
requirements.Rationale: Order status visibility addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
requirements.Acceptance: NS-ORD-1001 shows 100 ordered, availability unresolved, requested receipt 9 October and no invented confirmation; unknown facts are labelled
requirements.Dependencies: Document relationships; FR-003; NFR-003; RULE-002
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-017;TC-021

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall check usable supply and commitments before promising quantity and date.
requirements.Rationale: Availability-based promises addresses PROB-002 and supports BR-002.
requirements.Acceptance: 100 ordered with only 60 confirmed available cannot be promised as 100 on the requested date; confirmed quantity/date and check time are retained
requirements.Dependencies: Stock accuracy; scheduling lead times; RULE-003
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-004

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall record customer agreement before splitting fulfilment.
requirements.Rationale: Partial delivery agreement addresses PROB-002 and supports BR-002.
requirements.Acceptance: With no partial-delivery permission, a 60/100 shipment is stopped for review; with recorded agreement, 60 can proceed and 40 remains open
requirements.Dependencies: FR-003; customer delivery policy; RULE-004
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-005;TC-006

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall hold blocked orders until the appropriate authorized review.
requirements.Rationale: Credit and order blocks addresses PROB-002 and supports BR-002.
requirements.Acceptance: An unresolved credit or manual order block prevents dispatch release; Sales cannot release a credit block; Finance review records decision, reason and actor
requirements.Dependencies: Credit limits; NFR-001; precise block configuration; RULE-005
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-007;TC-008

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall record actual pick, dispatch, goods-issue posting and customer receipt separately.
requirements.Rationale: Fulfilment and posting evidence addresses PROB-002 and supports BR-002.
requirements.Acceptance: Picked/shipped quantities do not exceed authorized remaining quantity; dispatch and posting dates remain distinct; receipt is never inferred from posting
requirements.Dependencies: FR-004; delivery documents; receipt evidence; RULE-006
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-005;TC-011

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall cancel unshipped demand without erasing transaction history.
requirements.Rationale: Controlled cancellation addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
requirements.Acceptance: Pre-dispatch cancellation records reason and removes demand from release queue; post-dispatch request routes to Finance/Warehouse review without deleting posted records
requirements.Dependencies: Document status checks; returns/reversal dependency; RULE-007
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-009;TC-010

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall review eligible dispatched deliveries without waiting for emailed paperwork.
requirements.Rationale: Billing readiness queue addresses PROB-003 and supports BR-003.
requirements.Acceptance: A goods-issued delivery enters the billing review population; blocked/incomplete entries show reason and owner; unbilled age remains visible
requirements.Dependencies: FR-006; billing relevance; daily review calendar; RULE-008
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-012;TC-022

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall bill eligible delivered quantities once and track posting/output status.
requirements.Rationale: Invoice creation and duplicate control addresses PROB-003 and supports BR-003.
requirements.Acceptance: For 60 brackets at £25, net billing is £1,500; retry must not create a second active charge for the same quantity; posting/output failures remain visible
requirements.Dependencies: FR-008; pricing/tax master data; document linkage; RULE-009
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-012;TC-013;TC-022

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall correct invoice errors through linked reviewed adjustments.
requirements.Rationale: Invoice correction addresses PROB-003 and supports BR-003.
requirements.Acceptance: A wrong-price invoice is marked disputed and routed for review; correction preserves original reference and reason; no silent overwrite of a posted invoice
requirements.Dependencies: Correction method and tax treatment unresolved; RULE-009
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-013

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall match full and partial receipts while exposing unallocated balances.
requirements.Rationale: Payment allocation addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
requirements.Acceptance: Against £1,500 net-only illustrative invoice, £900 allocation leaves £600 analytical balance; unmatched £200 stays unallocated; allocation cannot exceed receipt or invoice balance
requirements.Dependencies: Customer reference; chosen partial vs residual policy; RULE-010
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-001;TC-014;TC-015;TC-016

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall assign each open exception to an owner and next action.
requirements.Rationale: Exception ownership addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
requirements.Priority_reason: Supports operation; interim documented control possible
requirements.Acceptance: Each open exception has order reference, category, accountable role and review date; overdue reviews appear in queue without exposing unauthorized finance detail
requirements.Dependencies: Role matrix; escalation policy; RULE-002
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-017

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall calculate consistent measures without multiplying order values.
requirements.Rationale: KPI definitions and reconciliation addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
requirements.Acceptance: Known fixture with two deliveries and two allocations retains one order value; cancelled/open/partial cases follow KPI contract; totals reconcile to source grains
requirements.Dependencies: Approved definitions; receipt capture; FR-006; FR-011; RULE-011
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-018

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall restrict sensitive actions to accountable roles.
requirements.Rationale: Role-based access addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
requirements.Acceptance: Warehouse cannot change credit limits; Sales cannot approve credit release; Finance can perform authorized review; both allowed and denied actions tested
requirements.Dependencies: NFR-001; named users; role design; RULE-005
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-007;TC-008;TC-019

requirements.Statement: The proposed process/solution shall trace critical changes and understand report freshness and errors.
requirements.Rationale: Audit and usable reporting addresses PROB-001 and supports BR-001.
requirements.Priority_reason: Supports operation; interim documented control possible
requirements.Acceptance: For promise/block/billing changes capture actor, time, before/after and reason; reports show as-of time; a user can locate order owner without a workaround
requirements.Dependencies: NFR-002;NFR-003;NFR-004;NFR-005; logging scope; RULE-012
requirements.Validation: Design walkthrough; planned SAP tests TC-020;TC-021

requirements.Statement: Access permissions shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
requirements.Rationale: Unauthorized financial actions are unacceptable, so tolerance is zero.
requirements.Priority_reason: Unauthorized financial actions are unacceptable, so tolerance is zero.
requirements.Acceptance: Every allow/deny action in the role matrix must match the proposed role restriction; zero unauthorized credit releases in the defined test set.
requirements.Dependencies: FR-014; RULE-005
requirements.Validation: Role matrix review and positive/negative system tests

requirements.Statement: Auditability shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
requirements.Rationale: All sampled critical events must be explainable; this is coverage, not a retention-law claim.
requirements.Priority_reason: All sampled critical events must be explainable; this is coverage, not a retention-law claim.
requirements.Acceptance: For every sampled promise, block release and invoice correction, retain actor, timestamp, before/after and reason; retention duration requires policy decision.
requirements.Dependencies: FR-015; record retention decision
requirements.Validation: Inspect audit records and compare controlled changes

requirements.Statement: Reporting timeliness shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
requirements.Rationale: A daily meeting is the business use case; real-time integration is not justified yet.
requirements.Priority_reason: A daily meeting is the business use case; real-time integration is not justified yet.
requirements.Acceptance: Daily management snapshot available before the proposed 09:00 Europe/London operations review with as-of timestamp; stale snapshot displays a warning.
requirements.Dependencies: FR-013; schedule; timezone conversion
requirements.Validation: Delay refresh deliberately and inspect timestamp/warning

requirements.Statement: Usability shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
requirements.Rationale: One person per role is formative coverage, not a statistically representative usability study.
requirements.Priority_reason: One person per role is formative coverage, not a statistically representative usability study.
requirements.Acceptance: Each of five proposed role representatives can locate an order, its owner and next action using the guide; record completion, errors and time before agreeing a timing target.
requirements.Dependencies: FR-002; FR-015; participants unavailable
requirements.Validation: Moderated tasks; no participants tested in this portfolio

requirements.Statement: Data quality and reconciliation shall meet the stated acceptance condition.
requirements.Rationale: Exact arithmetic is appropriate for keys and ledger-like reconciliation; incomplete business data is separately flagged.
requirements.Priority_reason: Exact arithmetic is appropriate for keys and ledger-like reconciliation; incomplete business data is separately flagged.
requirements.Acceptance: Required keys are unique/non-null, child references valid, quantities and allocations within parent bounds, and integer-pence balances reconcile exactly.
requirements.Dependencies: FR-013; data dictionary
requirements.Validation: Executed Python/SQLite checks; SAP extraction validation still required

evidence.Title: Understanding the Sell from Stock Process
evidence.Claim: BD9 connects sales order, outbound delivery, picking, goods issue and billing. Goods issue records stock movement and cost; billing supports revenue and receivables postings.
evidence.Limit: Learning page is not release-pinned; validate actual scope and posting behaviour in selected tenant.

evidence.Title: Understanding Sales Functions
evidence.Claim: Availability and scheduling depend on master data and check settings; confirmed quantities and dates can differ from the requested date.
evidence.Limit: No check scope or scheduling parameters configured or demonstrated.

evidence.Title: Understanding Shipping Functions
evidence.Claim: Outbound deliveries support shipping. Complete/partial delivery settings can be maintained and carried into orders.
evidence.Locator: Processing Outbound Deliveries; Complete and Partial Delivery
evidence.Limit: Customer agreement capture and exact restriction behaviour require validation.

evidence.Title: Understanding Billing Functions
evidence.Claim: Billing due items can be processed manually or through scheduled jobs; accounts receivable follows billing in J59.
evidence.Limit: Job timing, errors, accounting release and output monitoring require tenant validation; no guaranteed automatic success.

evidence.Title: Maintaining Business Partner Master Data
evidence.Claim: The business partner model centrally maintains common data with role-specific customer information.
evidence.Limit: Required fields, duplicate detection and approval design are project needs, not verified defaults.

evidence.Title: Posting Manual Incoming Payments
evidence.Claim: Partial payments leave the original invoice open with a linked payment item; residual handling clears it and creates a remaining item. On-account posting is possible.
evidence.Limit: Mixed-edition course includes a Public Edition example. Learning content is not release-pinned. Allocation CSV is an analytical model, not SAP journal structure.

rules.rule: Before confirmation require active customer, ship-to, product, positive quantity, valid price, currency and requested date. Drafts may be incomplete.
rules.rationale: Avoid knowingly releasing incomplete orders; field list proposed, not a SAP default.

rules.rule: Every open exception needs one accountable role, next action and next review date.
rules.rationale: Daily review proposed to prevent unowned handoffs.

rules.rule: Keep requested receipt and initial confirmed receipt dates separately; later changes must not overwrite the original promise.
rules.rationale: Prevents improving on-time delivery by moving the denominator date.

rules.rule: Partial deliveries require customer agreement recorded on the order; default to review when unknown.
rules.rationale: A partial shipment can add cost or disrupt customer operations.

rules.rule: Credit release is a Finance responsibility; Sales and Warehouse may request review but not self-release. Manual order blocks retain their own reasons.
rules.rationale: Separation of duties; actual authorization model unvalidated.

rules.rule: Capture dispatch, goods-issue posting and receipt as separate events. Never treat goods issue as proof of customer receipt.
rules.rationale: Correct service measurement and posting reconciliation.

rules.rule: Cancel before dispatch only after checking dependent documents; after dispatch route to controlled return/reversal review.
rules.rationale: Avoid deleting history; full returns redesign is out of scope.

rules.rule: Finance reviews billable and unbilled exceptions each business day; escalate items still unbilled on the next review.
rules.rationale: Proposed daily operating cadence, not a proven 24-hour SAP service level.

rules.rule: Bill only eligible quantity once; preserve correction links and original posted documents.
rules.rationale: Invoice correctness and retry safety; exact system configuration unresolved.

rules.rule: Allocate only to supported customer/invoice matches; preserve partial and unallocated balances without automatic write-off.
rules.rationale: No invented tolerance or forced clearing.

rules.rule: Aggregate child records to their intended parent grain before combining measures.
Show report as-of time and preserve critical change history; do not present missing evidence as zero.
